question: Why does a Georgia peach logo appear in the end credits of so many blockbusters?
answer: It is worth 10% of the budget spent there. Since 2008 Georgia has given productions a tax credit of 20% of qualifying local spending, plus 10% for showing the state's logo, and a production owing no Georgia tax can sell the credit to one that does. Studios built soundstages outside Atlanta to collect it.
move: Follow a location decision back to the tax code before the scenery.
reference: Georgia Entertainment Industry Investment Act, O.C.G.A. § 48-7-40.26, 2008
